text:
Ella (Design): mockups here -> https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/onboard-auto-sample?node-id=0%3A1
Ella (Design): thinking about making the quickstart try to auto-detect a repo language and suggest 2 sample projects instead of a generic list. demo flow in figma.
Sam (PM): +1 on reducing friction. question: what happens if detection is wrong? quick fallback copy?
Ella (Design): fallback is explicit: "Didn't match? Pick a sample or create your own" with a small 'skip detection' link. want copy options.
Lee (DevEx): love the idea. small concern: adding detection step might delay the initial banner load. can we async-detect after UI shows?
Morgan (Eng): yep, run detection in background and show placeholder cards. detection result just replaces cards; no blocking network call on critical path.
Kai (A11y): accessibility heads-up: if we swap cards after load, we must manage focus and announce changes to screen readers. aria-live or a clear heading update.
Ella (Design): good call — propose `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the card container and a visually-hidden status like "Suggested samples ready".
Sam (PM): also think about privacy: detection requires reading repo URL / package.json. add a short disclosure: "We inspect your repo to suggest starter projects — nothing leaves your workspace".
Morgan (Eng): implementation note: run detection in client, use a shallow parse of repo files. we should avoid sending contents to backend unless user accepts a sample template.
Lee (DevEx): UI nit: if detection returns multiple matches (JS + Python), do we show both? maybe prioritize by "most common files" and still allow toggling.
Ella (Design): mock shows two cards: "Suggested: Node Quickstart" and "Also relevant: Python Embeddings demo". small pill to switch languages.
Kai (A11y): when toggling languages, ensure keyboard focus lands on the newly revealed primary CTA. also include `aria-pressed` for the pill buttons.
Sam (PM): copy proposals for the banner:
- Option A: "We found starter projects that match your repo — try one to get up and running quickly."
- Option B (short): "Suggested starters for this repo. Pick one to begin."
Ella (Design): leaning to Option A but trimmed: "We found starter projects that match your repo. Pick one to get started."
Lee (DevEx): suggestion to surface estimated time to run (e.g., "~5 min") on each sample card — helps set expectation.
Morgan (Eng): technical constraint: build time estimate depends on user's infra. we can show rough category: "Quick (under 5 min)" vs "Setup (10+ min)".
Ella (Design): will update mock to include the time pill and the privacy link. also adding a tiny help icon linking to docs.
onboard-bot: Deploy preview generated for feature/auto-detect-samples — https://preview.redwood.ai/auto-detect-samples (staging)
Sam (PM): quick UX question: When user skips detection, do we remember choice? i'd prefer remembering for the session at least.
Morgan (Eng): store a session flag in local storage; persist in profile only if they explicitly opt-in to personalized suggestions.
Kai (A11y): checklist before shipping: 1) aria-live announcement on card replacement, 2) focus management on language pill/toggle, 3) keyboard order for cards, 4) accessible disclosure for repo inspection.
Ella (Design): thanks — I'll update the figma and copy. will post an updated prototype by EOD. anyone want to pair on the a11y flows?
Lee (DevEx): I can pair tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Sam (PM): perfect — I'll file a small ticket to track privacy copy and telemetry.
Ella (Design): cool, closing loop — will ping when updated mock is ready. :sparkles:
